name: CEPF Wallacea Biodiversity Hotspot grants
summary: CEPF small and large grants for biodiversity conservation in the Wallacea hotspot in eastern Indonesia, with Burung Indonesia handling small grants as the regional implementation team.
reporting: Large-grant holders file financial reports every quarter and progress reports every six months through CEPF’s online system.

steps: Full proposal (large grants) or more information (small grants), if invited

eligibility.rule: If government-owned: independent legal personality, can receive private funds, no sovereign immunity claim
The project supports at least one strategic direction in the ecosystem profile
The project does not violate CEPF's safeguard policies
Project does not resettle people or buy land

access.quote: Applicants for large grants must apply via CEPF's online system, ConservationGrants, via this link.

window.quote: Closing Date - Large Grants: Sunday, 27 September 2026, 11:00 a.m., Western Indonesia Time (Jakarta)

amount.quote: CEPF large grants for this call will be between $50,000 and $150,000.

reporting.quote: Recipients of large grants must submit financial reports each quarter and progress reports every six months through ConservationGrants.

effort.quote: Large-grant applicants submit letters of inquiry online, through the online grants database ConservationGrants. Small-grant applicants submit letters of inquiry using an offline template that will be provided in the open call instructions.

These applicants will have a defined period of time (typically around two months, although this may vary among hotspots) to submit a complete project proposal through the online portal ConservationGrants.
Successful small-grant applicants do not need to submit a project proposal; however, the RIT may request additional information
If a project triggers one or more safeguard policies, the grantee will be asked to prepare the relevant safeguard document(s)

eligibility.quote: If you represent a government-owned enterprise or institution, you are eligible only if you can establish that the enterprise or institution: Has a legal personality independent of any government agency or actor Has the authority to apply for and receive private funds May not assert a claim of sovereign immunity
The project must also support at least one strategic direction outlined in the CEPF ecosystem profile for the hotspot
In addition, the project must not violate CEPF's safeguard policies
Physical resettlement of people (voluntary or involuntary). Purchase of land.

after_award.quote: Recipients of large grants must submit financial reports each quarter
Large-grant recipients are required to attend a CEPF online orientation training within the first three months of their project's start date.
Members of the CEPF Secretariat and the RITs perform financial supervision missions and programmatic site visits to selected grantees each year.
